description: 嘉油鐵馬道自行車道路線圖 [roads, bridges and tunnels and cycling and walking networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 嘉義市政府. 嘉油鐵馬道係利用閒置的中油舊鐵道修築，以嘉義市世賢路四段中油廠區旁為起點，途經美源、光路、湖內等三里，及嘉義縣水上鄉。 抵達終點鴿溪寮站後，與北回自行車道相接。 請使用GIS軟體(例如Google Earth)匯入KML圖資。. Coverage: 嘉義市政府. The portal files it under the publisher 嘉義市政府. Its tags are 休閒旅遊. It offers 1 resource(s) in kmz. The portal shows 2025-10-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
